name: git
description: Git repository operations — status, diff, log, commit, branch, blame
pitfalls: Operates on the repository in the current working directory
git_commit and git_add are write operations — mcptoon's dangerous-op guard may flag them
No remote operations (push/pull) — use the GitHub MCP for remote actions
notes: Local git operations without needing GitHub API. Perfect for AI agents that need to inspect code changes, create commits, and manage branches.

permissions: read: status, diff, log, blame, branches
write: add, commit, reset, checkout, create branch
